entities.name: Sonogashira coupling of bromo scaffold
observations: The reaction replaces the C–Br bond on the complex substrate with a bond to the terminal carbon of an alkyl-substituted alkyne; the C≡C bond is retained.
The transformation is assigned as a Sonogashira-type C(sp)–C(sp2/vinyl or aryl) coupling.
The exact full-substrate condition was not identified; recommendations are based on close ORD analogs.

entities.name: PdCl2(PPh3)2 CuI Et3N
observations: Close precedent: PdCl2(PPh3)2 with CuI and triethylamine couples a terminal alkyl alkyne with an aryl bromide; reported yield 88.7%, ORD record ord-36825357a8654c3ebe21c8be8ba058ad.
Recommended as the first screening condition for the supplied transformation, typically with 1–5 mol% palladium catalyst and 1–10 mol% CuI.

entities.name: Pd(PPh3)4 CuI amine base
observations: Related precedent uses Pd(PPh3)4, CuI, and diethylamine in MTBE at 65 °C for 2 hours, giving 98% coupling product; ORD record ord-8dad396f3ce54dedb821e8934b0d99ba.
Triethylamine, diethylamine, or diisopropylamine are plausible amine bases for this coupling.

entities.name: PPh3 CuI DIPEA THF
observations: Related precedent uses PPh3/CuI with diisopropylamine in THF at 70 °C and reports 99.4% yield; ORD record ord-85ce27a8261a469f87676f69f87f8d51.
THF or MTBE are practical solvent alternatives when the amine is not used as solvent.
